csv_scope_of_work: Agency is seeking a qualified firm to provide professional Architectural and Engineering design services to produce studies, plans and specifications and contract administration for the construction of seven, 8-bed dormitory/living quarter units of approximately 5,500 square foot each in dimension.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Structural Engineering
csv_comments: '- Project Number: 710-RFQ-2701- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 06/01/2026 02:00 PM CDT
title: AE for New Dormitory Buildings
short_description: Design services for seven new dormitory buildings at a Booneville campus site.
project_scope: Professional architectural and engineering design services for the construction of seven dormitory/living quarter units, each with 8 beds and approximately 5,500 square feet. Total planned gross floor area is approximately 38,500 square feet. Services include studies, plans and specifications, and contract administration.
services: Architectural and engineering design services, including architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, structural engineering, preparation of studies, plans and specifications, and contract administration.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project with structural engineering included.
- Total size is moderate at about 38,500 square feet across seven small dormitory buildings.
- Dormitory/residential buildings are generally less aligned with sbp's core focus than bridges, long-span roofs, stadiums, or special structures.
- No indication of unusual spans, innovative structural systems, lightweight construction, or sustainability ambitions.
- Early-stage design scope is positive, but overall structural ambition appears limited.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available basis for a rough estimate: seven new dormitory/living quarter units, each about 5,500 square feet, totaling about 38,500 square feet, with full A/E design and contract administration services requested.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source.
references_qualifications: Qualified firm for professional architectural and engineering design services; requested disciplines are architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, and structural engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: Arkansas Department of Human Services, Booneville, Arkansas, USA. Contact: Craig A. Parsons. Phone: 501-682-6551. Fax: 501-682-1483. Email: Craig.Parsons@dhs.arkansas.gov. Website: https://humanservices.arkansas.gov/procurement_categories/requests-for-qualifications/
notes: Project number: 710-RFQ-2701. Questions deadline: 2026-06-01 02:00 PM CDT. Target market listed as Universities/Colleges, but contracting authority is the Arkansas Department of Human Services. Source does not provide budget, fee, or explicit award weighting.
